description.narrative: The programme will provide central FCDO capabilities for responding to humanitarian crisis, conflict and insecurity out to 2030. Innovative early warning and risk analysis tools will provide the evidence base for FCDO's work and maintain UK responsiveness to global events. A standing humanitarian advisory team will provide leading-edge technical advice in support of preparedness and response to both emergency and protracted crises. Scalable expertise will bring agility to HMG's work on humanitarian crisis, conflict and insecurity - providing advice and support on prevention and response. A humanitarian procurement and logistics service will source, stockpile and deploy equipment and humanitarian relief at speed and scale, providing those in greatest need with what they need to survive and recover from crisis.
